channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Flatlines around 218.50 with long-term highs at hand
item.description: GBP/JPY wavers around 218.50, with bears contained above previous highs at 218.00.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ expectations skewed to upside – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad expects Japan’s June Consumer Price Index (CPI) to edge higher across headline and core measures, with core ex fresh food and energy steady at 1.8%.

item.title: Euro: Growth validation needed for value case – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu argues that Euro (EUR) assets show emerging value as the European Central Bank (ECB) holds policy and inflation pressures ease, but stresses that Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data and earnings must confirm stable growth.

item.title: Euro holds steady vs Japanese Yen ahead of ECB, BoJ meetings
item.description: EUR/JPY trades around 185.70 on Monday at the time of writing, showing little direction after a quiet start to the week.

item.title: CEE FX: Risk-off keeps pressure on forint – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky notes that escalating US-Iran tensions are driving risk-off sentiment, overshadowing a light Central and Eastern Europe data calendar.

item.title: Indian Rupee weakens due to surging oil price gains, FIIs outflow
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a weak note against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair jumps to near 96.46 as a fresh surge in oil prices and the consistent outflow of foreign funds from the Indian stock market are hurting the Indian currency.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: Lags as MNB cuts loom – Societe Generale
item.description: Société Générale identifies the Hungarian forint as July’s main Central and Eastern European (CEE) laggard, with EUR/HUF moving back above 363 as markets anticipate another 25bp central bank of Hungary Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB) rate cut to 5.75%.

item.title: Iran's Baghaei: Intermediaries share messages with Tehran over recent days
item.description: Esmaeil Baghaei Hamaneh, a spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran, said during the European trading session on Monday that Tehran pursues war and diplomacy based on its national interests when asked whether the door to talks with the United States (US) was now closed, Reuters repor

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $56.83 per troy ounce, up 1.49% from the $56.00 it cost on Friday.

item.title: Brent: Energy risks rise with Hormuz tensions – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s RaboResearch Global Economics & Markets team highlights that Brent Oil trading near $90 and elevated crack spreads underscore tight energy conditions as geopolitical risks escalate around Iran and Hormuz.

item.title: Australian Dollar rises against Japanese Yen due to RBA-BoJ rate differential
item.description: AUD/JPY rises after two days of losses, trading around 113.60 during the European hours on Monday. The currency cross appreciates as the Australian Dollar (AUD) holds gains following the release of the interest rate decision by the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), China's central bank.

item.title: British Pound: Outperformance on yields and politics repricing – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman highlights the Pound as the best performing major currency in recent weeks, supported by higher UK real yields and favourable carry conditions.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Forms Symmetrical Triangle near multi-decade highs
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: Euro: Energy and spreads shape near-term path – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner highlights that with Brent above $90, EUR/USD might normally trade below 1.14, but tighter correlation between energy and short-dated Euro swap rates is offering support.

item.title: Gold bulls seem hesitant as reviving Fed hike bets counter USD weakness
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to its modest intraday gains through the first half of the European session on Monday amid a softer US Dollar, though it lacks follow-through buying, warranting caution for bullish traders.

item.title: Canadian Dollar holds near monthly highs with Inflation data in the spotlight
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) holds gains near one-month highs against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday.

item.title: Swiss Franc remains on the front foot against USD as traders eyes geopolitics, Fed bets
item.description: The USD/CHF pair turns lower for the second straight day following an intraday uptick to the 0.8100 neighborhood and touches a fresh daily low during the first half of the European session on Monday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Soft inflation supports extended BoC pause – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad looks for Canada June headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) to slow to 2.9% year-on-year, with core measures near 2%.

item.title: British Pound gains as Andy Burnham to become new Prime Minister
item.description: GBP/USD gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 1.3470 during the European hours on Monday.

item.title: Brent: Geopolitical risks drive the biggest gain since April – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight a sharp rebound in Brent Oil as US–Iran tensions escalate, with Brent posting its biggest weekly gain since April and extending gains this morning.

item.title: Australian Dollar looks to build on strength above 0.7000 vs a weaker USD
item.description: The AUD/USD pair hits a fresh daily high during the early part of the European session on Monday, with bulls now looking to build on the intraday move up beyond the 0.7000 psychological mark amid a weaker US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Australian Dollar: Uptrend risk intact above 0.6950 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes AUD/USD slipped below prior consolidation but still trades within 0.6960–0.7000 intraday. On a 1–3 week view, earlier strong momentum toward 0.7045 has faded somewhat, yet the upside scenario remains valid while 0.6950 holds.

item.title: Dow Jones futures advance as traders expect Fed to hold rates steady in July
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain 0.14% to trade around 52,450 during European trading hours on Monday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq 100 futures advance 0.26% and 0.50%, trading near 7,520 and 28,920, respectively.

item.title: ECB's SAFE survey predicts slowdown in growth in selling prices and non-labor cost
item.description: According to the European Central Bank’s (ECB) Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises (SAFE), more than 5,000 firms that participated have downplayed expectations for an increase in selling prices.

item.title: British Pound: Burnham honeymoon meets fiscal reality – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner writes that Sterling has benefited from expectations Andy Burnham will appoint a fiscally cautious chancellor, alongside stale short positioning and M&A-related flows into United Kingdom (UK) equities.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Resumes the bullish trend and tests monthly highs around 0.5860
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) resumed its broader bullish trend against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, following a mild pullback over the previous two trading days.

item.title: Euro holds early recovery against US Dollar, focus is on ECB policy
item.description: The Euro (EUR) holds its early recovery move at around 1.1450 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: 1.3970 in Focus against US Dollar – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale technical analysts highlight that USD/CAD failed to sustain a break above 1.4130, triggering a deeper pullback. The pair is drifting towards the 50-DMA and March peak near 1.3970, seen as key support.

item.title: Euro remains weaker against Canadian Dollar as German PPI falls in June
item.description: EUR/CAD remains in negative territory after paring daily losses, trading around 1.6030 during the early European hours on Monday. The currency cross depreciates as the Euro (EUR) struggles following the release of Germany’s Producer Price Index (PPI) data.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD bulls await breakout through trend-line hurdle near $57.25
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) sticks to its modest intraday gains during the early European session on Monday and currently trades just below the $57.00 mark, up over 1.50% for the day.
